concept: Contributing to a cause or community effort bigger than your own immediate interests
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student considers a realistic volunteer or community contribution opportunity that offers little personal benefit
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to get involved
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real, specific way they could contribute to something beyond themselves

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, realistic contribution, not a vague intention
